## 修复与体验

notesEn:
Released 2026-08-21. Support entry points now match the AI-only ticket policy and no longer mislabel Xiaoyue AI as human support.

## Fixes and usability

- **Consistent AI support:** the diagnostic page's external support action, error message, and next-step guidance now point explicitly to Xiaoyue AI without promising a human handoff.
- **Automated ticket closure:** Xiaoyue AI continues to ask follow-up questions, verify available facts, and reply in the same ticket. Refunds and withdrawals remain available through their dedicated self-service pages.

## Compatibility

- The adaptive Hysteria 2 congestion control, network-type telemetry, and hot-reload attribution introduced in v1.3.9 remain unchanged.
- Existing subscriptions, accounts, and node-selection behavior are unchanged; this release does not redefine protocols or routes.
